historical_record.description: The Recreation and Park Commission awarded the contract to build the playground's field house to Wm. McIntosh & Son at $25,404, from four bids, under the 1947 recreation bond program.
The Mayor approved a schedule dedicating six new playgrounds of the 1947 recreation bond program, with West Portal Playground set for June 1.
The Recreation Commission engaged William G. Merchant, architect, to design a clubhouse at West Portal Playground, on an estimated cost of $20,000.
